### filter most abundant asvs
```{r}
# filter asvs to keep the most abundant ones and statistically significant asvs via metagenomeseq linear models
##################################################################################################################################

# Calculate the variance for each taxon across different levels of 'sex'
#abundance_by_asv <- rowSums(picrust.kegg)
abundance_by_asv <- apply(otu_table(ps.f), 1, function(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE))

# Convert the result to a data frame for easier manipulation
abundance_df <- data.frame(asv = taxa_names(ps.f), abundance = abundance_by_asv)

# Sort taxa based on variance in descending order
abundance_df <- abundance_df[order(-abundance_df$abundance), ]

# Extract the names of the top taxa
top_asv_names <- abundance_df$asv[1:100]

# Filter the phyloseq object to keep only the top taxa
ps.filtered <- prune_taxa(c(top_asv_names, sex_asv_names) , ps.f)

# female: Infant_gender == 2
ps_female <- subset_samples(ps.filtered, Infant_gender == 1)

# male: Infant_gender == 1
ps_male <- subset_samples(ps.filtered, Infant_gender == 0)

# delete files
rm(ps.f)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(ps_male, file = here("data/spieceasi/microbes/ps_male_asv.rds"))
```

# Bootstrapping SPIEC-Easi

## bootstrap function
```{r}
# subset data function
subset_data <- function(input_data) {
  num_rows <- nrow(input_data)
  sample_size <- round(0.8 * num_rows)
  sampled_data <- input_data[sample(seq_len(num_rows), size = sample_size), , drop = FALSE]
  return(sampled_data)
}
```

```{r}
# bootstrap function below
run_bootstrapped_spiec_easi <- function(input_phyloseq, n = 100) {
  ### This function takes a phyloseq object as input and outputs bootstrapped spieceasi correlation matrices ###
  ################################################################################################################################
  cov_matrix_original <- list()
  cov_matrix_shuffled <- list()
  
  # maybe want this to be a user defined variable outside of the function????
  pargs1 <- list(rep.num=50, seed=10010, ncores=8)
  
  # Convert phyloseq object to a data frame
  input_data <- as(t(otu_table(input_phyloseq)), "matrix")
  
  cov_matrix_original <- list()
  cov_matrix_shuffled <- list()
  # create for loop for n iterations
  for (i in 1:n) {
    print(i)
    # Randomly select 80% of the data
    sampled_data <- subset_data(input_data)
  
    # Run spieceasi on the sampled data
    sp_og <- spiec.easi(data = sampled_data, method='glasso',sel.criterion='stars', pulsar.select=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio=1e-2,
                           nlambda=20, pulsar.params=pargs1)
    cov_matrix_original[[i]] <- cov2cor(getOptCov(sp_og))
    
    # Shuffle data across columns (keeping row sums constant)
    shuffled_data <- apply(sampled_data, 2, function(x) sample(x))
    
    # Run spieceasi on the shuffled data
    cov_matrix_shuffled[[i]] <- cov2cor(getOptCov(spiec.easi(data = shuffled_data, method='glasso',sel.criterion='stars', pulsar.select=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio=1e-2,
                           nlambda=20, pulsar.params=pargs1)))
    
  }
  # Return the covariance matrices
  result <- list(original = cov_matrix_original, shuffled = cov_matrix_shuffled)
  return(result)

}
```

### function to extract elements from vector
```{r}
extract_elements <- function(matrix_list) {
  ################################################################################################################################
  # Get the number of matrices in the list
  num_matrices <- length(matrix_list)
  
  # Check if the list is not empty
  if (num_matrices == 0) {
    stop("Input list is empty.")
  }
  
  # Get the dimensions of the first matrix
  num_rows <- nrow(matrix_list[[1]])
  num_cols <- ncol(matrix_list[[1]])
  
  # Initialize an empty list to store extracted elements
  extracted_elements <- vector("list", length = num_rows * num_cols)
  
  # Loop through each position in the matrices
  for (i in 1:num_rows) {
    for (j in 1:num_cols) {
      # Extract elements from the same position in each matrix
      position_elements <- sapply(matrix_list, function(mat) mat[i, j])
      
      # Store the extracted elements in the list
      extracted_elements[[(i - 1) * num_cols + j]] <- position_elements
    }
  }
  
  return(extracted_elements)
}
```


# write function that performs t-test on each 
```{r}
paired_t_test <- function(list1, list2) {
  ################################################################################################################################
  # Check if the lists have the same length
  if (length(list1) != length(list2)) {
    stop("Input lists must have the same length.")
  }
  
  # Initialize an empty list to store p-values
  p_values <- vector("numeric", length = length(list1))
  
  # Perform paired t-tests for each pair of items
  for (i in seq_along(list1)) {
    result <- t.test(list1[[i]], list2[[i]], paired = TRUE)
    
    # Store the p-value in the list
    p_values[i] <- result$p.value
  }
  
  # convert listed p-values into matrix
  p_values <- matrix(p_values, nrow = sqrt(length(list1)))
  return(p_values)
}
```

## Identify q-val cutoff using pracma package
```{r}
# Convert the p-value matrix to a vector, excluding NAs (diagonal)
pval_vector <- as.vector(p_val_mat_f[upper.tri(p_val_mat_f, diag = FALSE)])

# Remove NA values (if any)
pval_vector <- pval_vector[!is.na(pval_vector)]

ggplot(data.frame(pval = pval_vector), aes(x = pval)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, fill = "steelblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of P-values",
       x = "P-value",
       y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data.frame(pval = pval_vector), aes(x = pval)) +
  geom_density(fill = "blue", alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(title = "Density Plot of P-values",
       x = "P-value",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
thresholds <- c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001, 1E-20)
sapply(thresholds, function(t) mean(pval_vector < t))

ggplot(data.frame(pval = pval_vector), aes(x = pval)) +
  stat_ecdf(geom = "step", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Cumulative Distribution of P-values",
       x = "P-value",
       y = "Cumulative Probability") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
# Compute density
pval_density <- density(pval_vector)

# Find local maxima (peaks)
library(pracma)  # Contains findpeaks() function
peaks <- findpeaks(pval_density$y, nups = 1, ndowns = 1, minpeakheight = 2)

# Extract the first peak and its corresponding p-value
first_peak_index <- peaks[1, 2]  # Index of the first peak
first_peak_pval <- pval_density$x[first_peak_index]  # Corresponding p-value

# Print the first peak p-value
print(paste("First peak p-value:", first_peak_pval))
```

```{r}
# Find local minima (valleys)
valleys <- findpeaks(-pval_density$y, nups = 1, ndowns = 1, minpeakheight = -2)

# Find the first valley to the right of the first peak
valleys_right <- valleys[valleys[, 2] > first_peak_index, , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(valleys_right) > 0) {
  right_cutoff_index <- valleys_right[1, 2]
  right_cutoff_pval <- pval_density$x[right_cutoff_index]
} else {
  right_cutoff_pval <- NA  # No clear right cutoff found
}

# Print the identified p-value cutoff
print(paste("Suggested p-value cutoff:", right_cutoff_pval))
```


```{r}
ggplot(data.frame(pval = pval_vector), aes(x = pval)) +
  geom_density(fill = "blue", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = first_peak_pval, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = right_cutoff_pval, color = "green", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Density Plot of P-values with Cutoff",
       x = "P-value",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
edge_mat_from_correlations <- function(
  p_val_mat,
  corr_list,
  pval_cutoff
) {

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Checks
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (nrow(p_val_mat) != ncol(p_val_mat)) {
    stop("p_val_mat must be a square matrix.")
  }

  n <- nrow(p_val_mat)

  if (length(corr_list) != n^2) {
    stop(
      "corr_list length does not match p-value matrix dimensions."
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Calculate mean bootstrap edge weight
  # for every matrix position
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  mean_correlations <- vapply(
    corr_list,
    function(x) {
      mean(
        x,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    },
    numeric(1)
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Reconstruct correlation matrix
  #
  # IMPORTANT:
  # extract_elements() stored positions row-by-row,
  # so use byrow = TRUE
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  corr_mat <- matrix(
    mean_correlations,
    nrow = n,
    ncol = n,
    byrow = TRUE
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Add taxa names
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  dimnames(corr_mat) <- dimnames(
    p_val_mat
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Keep only significant edges
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  keep <- (
    !is.na(p_val_mat) &
    p_val_mat < pval_cutoff
  )

  # Remove self-edges
  diag(keep) <- FALSE

  corr_mat[
    !keep
  ] <- 0


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Return filtered edge matrix
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  return(
    corr_mat
  )
}
```

## prep for cytoscape
### edge table
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# ============================================================
# Convert filtered adjacency matrix to Cytoscape edge list
# ============================================================

matrix_to_edge_list <- function(mat) {

  mat <- as.matrix(mat)

  # Keep upper triangle only so each edge appears once
  idx <- which(
    upper.tri(mat) &
      mat != 0,
    arr.ind = TRUE
  )

  edge_list <- data.frame(
    source = rownames(mat)[idx[, 1]],
    target = colnames(mat)[idx[, 2]],
    weight = mat[idx],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      abs_weight = abs(weight),
      interaction = if_else(
        weight > 0,
        "positive",
        "negative"
      )
    )

  return(edge_list)
}


# ============================================================
# Female network
# ============================================================

edges_cytoscape_f <- matrix_to_edge_list(
  test_f_filtered
)


# ============================================================
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. Load files
# ============================================================
sex_microbes <- read.csv(file =  here("data/MaasLin2/asvs_zinb/sex_ega_sig_microbes.csv"), row.names = 1)

asv_kegg <-
  read.table(
      file=here('data/picrust2/picrust_output_css_all/KO_predicted.tsv.gz'),
      sep='\t',
      header=TRUE,
      row.names = 1,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


# ============================================================
# 1. Identify differentially abundant ASVs
# ============================================================

da_asvs <- unique(sex_microbes$feature)


# ============================================================
# 2. Identify GUSB-expressing ASVs
#    K01195 = beta-glucuronidase
# ============================================================

gusb_asvs <- rownames(asv_kegg)[
  !is.na(asv_kegg[, "K01195"]) &
    asv_kegg[, "K01195"] > 0
]


# ============================================================
# 3. Add node-information labels
# ============================================================

nodes_f <- data.frame(
  ASV = nodes_f
)

nodes_f <- nodes_f %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    node_info = case_when(
      ASV %in% da_asvs & ASV %in% gusb_asvs ~ "DA_GUSB",
      ASV %in% da_asvs ~ "DA",
      ASV %in% gusb_asvs ~ "GUSB",
      TRUE ~ "A"
    )
  )

nodes_m <- data.frame(
  ASV = nodes_m
)

nodes_m <- nodes_m %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    node_info = case_when(
      ASV %in% da_asvs & ASV %in% gusb_asvs ~ "DA_GUSB",
      ASV %in% da_asvs ~ "DA",
      ASV %in% gusb_asvs ~ "GUSB",
      TRUE ~ "A"
    )
  )


# Optional: set order for plotting
nodes_f$node_info <- factor(
  nodes_f$node_info,
  levels = c("A", "GUSB", "DA", "DA_GUSB")
)

nodes_m$node_info <- factor(
  nodes_m$node_info,
  levels = c("A", "GUSB", "DA", "DA_GUSB")
)
```

# graph properties
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Compare two signed, weighted, undirected GraphML networks
#
# Metrics:
#
# Global:
#   - Average shortest path length
#   - Global clustering coefficient
#   - Percent negative edges
#
# Node:
#   - Degree
#   - Local clustering coefficient
#   - Closeness centrality
#   - Eccentricity
#   - Stress centrality
#   - Betweenness centrality
#
# Edge:
#   - Edge betweenness
#   - Edge sign
#   - Sign changes between male and female networks
#
# IMPORTANT:
# Signed weights are NOT used as distances.
# All path-based network statistics use unweighted topology.
# Edge weights are retained only for sign comparisons.
# ============================================================

library(igraph)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(here)


# ============================================================
# INPUT
# ============================================================

graph1_file <- here(
  "data/cytoscape/male_network.graphml"
)

graph2_file <- here(
  "data/cytoscape/female_network.graphml"
)

outdir <- here(
  "data/cytoscape/network_comparison"
)

dir.create(
  outdir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

message("Output directory: ", outdir)


# ============================================================
# LOAD GRAPHS
# ============================================================

g1 <- igraph::read_graph(
  graph1_file,
  format = "graphml"
)

g2 <- igraph::read_graph(
  graph2_file,
  format = "graphml"
)


# ============================================================
# GRAPH QC FUNCTION
# ============================================================

check_graph <- function(
  g,
  graph_name
) {

  message(
    "Checking ",
    graph_name,
    "..."
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Must be undirected
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (igraph::is_directed(g)) {
    stop(
      graph_name,
      " is directed. Expected an undirected graph."
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Weight attribute must exist
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (!"weight" %in% igraph::edge_attr_names(g)) {
    stop(
      graph_name,
      " does not contain an edge attribute named 'weight'."
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Vertex names are required for graph comparison
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (!"name" %in% igraph::vertex_attr_names(g)) {
    stop(
      graph_name,
      " does not contain vertex names."
    )
  }

  node_names <- as.character(
    igraph::V(g)$name
  )

  if (anyNA(node_names)) {
    stop(
      graph_name,
      " contains missing vertex names."
    )
  }

  if (any(node_names == "")) {
    stop(
      graph_name,
      " contains empty vertex names."
    )
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(node_names) > 0) {
    stop(
      graph_name,
      " contains duplicated vertex names."
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Convert weights to numeric
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  weights_numeric <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      igraph::E(g)$weight
    )
  )

  if (
    length(weights_numeric) !=
      igraph::ecount(g)
  ) {
    stop(
      graph_name,
      ": could not convert edge weights correctly."
    )
  }

  if (anyNA(weights_numeric)) {
    stop(
      graph_name,
      " contains missing or non-numeric edge weights."
    )
  }

  igraph::E(g)$weight <- weights_numeric

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Warn about loops or multiple edges
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (any(igraph::which_loop(g))) {
    warning(
      graph_name,
      " contains self-loops."
    )
  }

  if (!igraph::is_simple(g)) {
    warning(
      graph_name,
      " is not a simple graph. ",
      "Parallel edges or self-loops may affect metrics."
    )
  }

  message(
    graph_name,
    ": ",
    igraph::vcount(g),
    " nodes, ",
    igraph::ecount(g),
    " edges"
  )

  message(
    graph_name,
    " weight range: ",
    paste(
      range(
        igraph::E(g)$weight
      ),
      collapse = " to "
    )
  )

  return(g)
}


# ============================================================
# RUN QC
# ============================================================

g1 <- check_graph(
  g1,
  "Male graph"
)

g2 <- check_graph(
  g2,
  "Female graph"
)


# ============================================================
# STRESS CENTRALITY
#
# Stress centrality = total number of shortest paths between
# all OTHER node pairs that pass through a node.
#
# We calculate this directly with igraph and avoid sna.
#
# Because the graph is undirected, each unordered pair i-j
# is evaluated exactly once.
# ============================================================

calculate_stress_centrality <- function(g) {

  n_nodes <- igraph::vcount(g)

  stress <- numeric(
    n_nodes
  )

  names(stress) <- igraph::V(g)$name

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Cannot have an internal node on a shortest path if the
  # network contains fewer than three nodes.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (n_nodes < 3) {
    return(stress)
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Loop over unordered source-target pairs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  for (i in seq_len(n_nodes - 1)) {

    for (j in seq.int(
      i + 1,
      n_nodes
    )) {

      shortest_paths_ij <- igraph::all_shortest_paths(
        g,
        from = i,
        to = j,
        mode = "all",
        weights = NA
      )$res

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Disconnected pair
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      if (length(shortest_paths_ij) == 0) {
        next
      }

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Count every geodesic separately
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      for (path in shortest_paths_ij) {

        path_nodes <- as.integer(
          path
        )

        # Direct edge:
        # no internal nodes
        if (length(path_nodes) <= 2) {
          next
        }

        internal_nodes <- path_nodes[
          2:(length(path_nodes) - 1)
        ]

        stress[
          internal_nodes
        ] <- stress[
          internal_nodes
        ] + 1
      }
    }
  }

  return(stress)
}


# ============================================================
# CALCULATE NETWORK PROPERTIES
# ============================================================

calculate_network_properties <- function(
  g,
  network_name
) {

  message(
    "\n============================================"
  )

  message(
    "Calculating network properties: ",
    network_name
  )

  message(
    "============================================"
  )

  # ==========================================================
  # COMPONENTS
  # ==========================================================

  comp <- igraph::components(
    g
  )

  largest_component_id <- which.max(
    comp$csize
  )

  largest_component_nodes <- which(
    comp$membership ==
      largest_component_id
  )

  g_lcc <- igraph::induced_subgraph(
    g,
    vids = largest_component_nodes
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # GLOBAL:
  # AVERAGE SHORTEST PATH LENGTH
  #
  # Calculated on largest connected component.
  # Signed weights are NOT used as distances.
  # ==========================================================

  if (igraph::vcount(g_lcc) > 1) {

    avg_shortest_path_length <- igraph::mean_distance(
      g_lcc,
      directed = FALSE,
      weights = NA,
      unconnected = FALSE
    )

  } else {

    avg_shortest_path_length <- NA_real_
  }


  # ==========================================================
  # GLOBAL:
  # CLUSTERING COEFFICIENT
  # ==========================================================

  clustering_coefficient <- igraph::transitivity(
    g,
    type = "global"
  )

  if (
    length(clustering_coefficient) == 0 ||
      is.nan(clustering_coefficient)
  ) {

    clustering_coefficient <- NA_real_
  }


  # ==========================================================
  # GLOBAL:
  # PERCENT NEGATIVE EDGES
  # ==========================================================

  n_edges <- igraph::ecount(
    g
  )

  n_negative_edges <- sum(
    igraph::E(g)$weight < 0
  )

  n_positive_edges <- sum(
    igraph::E(g)$weight > 0
  )

  n_zero_edges <- sum(
    igraph::E(g)$weight == 0
  )

  percent_negative_edges <- if (
    n_edges > 0
  ) {

    100 *
      n_negative_edges /
      n_edges

  } else {

    NA_real_
  }


  # ==========================================================
  # GLOBAL TABLE
  # ==========================================================

  global_stats <- tibble(
    network = network_name,

    n_nodes = igraph::vcount(g),

    n_edges = n_edges,

    n_positive_edges =
      n_positive_edges,

    n_negative_edges =
      n_negative_edges,

    n_zero_edges =
      n_zero_edges,

    percent_negative_edges =
      percent_negative_edges,

    average_shortest_path_length =
      avg_shortest_path_length,

    clustering_coefficient =
      clustering_coefficient
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # NODE:
  # DEGREE
  # ==========================================================

  message(
    "Calculating degree..."
  )

  node_degree <- igraph::degree(
    g,
    mode = "all",
    loops = FALSE
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # NODE:
  # LOCAL CLUSTERING COEFFICIENT
  # ==========================================================

  message(
    "Calculating local clustering coefficient..."
  )

  node_clustering <- igraph::transitivity(
    g,
    type = "local",
    isolates = "zero"
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # NODE:
  # CLOSENESS CENTRALITY
  # ==========================================================

  message(
    "Calculating closeness..."
  )

  node_closeness <- igraph::closeness(
    g,
    mode = "all",
    weights = NA,
    normalized = TRUE
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # NODE:
  # ECCENTRICITY
  # ==========================================================

  message(
    "Calculating eccentricity..."
  )

  node_eccentricity <- igraph::eccentricity(
    g,
    mode = "all",
    weights = NA
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # NODE:
  # BETWEENNESS CENTRALITY
  # ==========================================================

  message(
    "Calculating betweenness..."
  )

  node_betweenness <- igraph::betweenness(
    g,
    directed = FALSE,
    weights = NA,
    normalized = TRUE
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # NODE:
  # STRESS CENTRALITY
  # ==========================================================

  message(
    "Calculating stress centrality..."
  )

  node_stress <- calculate_stress_centrality(
    g
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # NODE TABLE
  # ==========================================================

  node_stats <- tibble(
    node = as.character(
      igraph::V(g)$name
    ),

    network = network_name,

    degree = as.numeric(
      node_degree
    ),

    clustering_coefficient =
      as.numeric(
        node_clustering
      ),

    closeness = as.numeric(
      node_closeness
    ),

    eccentricity = as.numeric(
      node_eccentricity
    ),

    stress = as.numeric(
      node_stress
    ),

    betweenness = as.numeric(
      node_betweenness
    )
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # EDGE:
  # ENDPOINTS
  # ==========================================================

  edge_ends <- igraph::ends(
    g,
    igraph::E(g),
    names = TRUE
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # EDGE:
  # BETWEENNESS
  # ==========================================================

  message(
    "Calculating edge betweenness..."
  )

  edge_bet <- igraph::edge_betweenness(
    g,
    directed = FALSE,
    weights = NA
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # EDGE TABLE
  # ==========================================================

  edge_stats <- tibble(
    from = as.character(
      edge_ends[, 1]
    ),

    to = as.character(
      edge_ends[, 2]
    ),

    network = network_name,

    weight = as.numeric(
      igraph::E(g)$weight
    ),

    edge_betweenness = as.numeric(
      edge_bet
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sign = case_when(
        weight > 0 ~ "positive",
        weight < 0 ~ "negative",
        weight == 0 ~ "zero",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Canonical ordering for an undirected edge.
      #
      # A--B and B--A therefore receive the same edge ID.
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      node1 = if_else(
        from <= to,
        from,
        to
      ),

      node2 = if_else(
        from <= to,
        to,
        from
      ),

      edge_id = paste(
        node1,
        node2,
        sep = "__"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      edge_id,
      node1,
      node2,
      network,
      weight,
      sign,
      edge_betweenness
    )


  # ==========================================================
  # RETURN
  # ==========================================================

  return(
    list(
      global = global_stats,
      nodes = node_stats,
      edges = edge_stats
    )
  )
}


# ============================================================
# CALCULATE MALE NETWORK
# ============================================================

results_g1 <- calculate_network_properties(
  g = g1,
  network_name = "male"
)


# ============================================================
# CALCULATE FEMALE NETWORK
# ============================================================

results_g2 <- calculate_network_properties(
  g = g2,
  network_name = "female"
)


# ============================================================

  pivot_longer(
    cols = -network,
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%

    names_from = network,

  ) %>%

    female_minus_male =

  )

print(
  global_difference

readr::write_csv(

  )
)


# ============================================================
# NODE COMPARISON
# ============================================================

node_comparison <- results_g1$nodes %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -network
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    degree_male =
      degree,

    clustering_coefficient_male =
      clustering_coefficient,

    closeness_male =
      closeness,

    eccentricity_male =
      eccentricity,

    stress_male =
      stress,

    betweenness_male =
      betweenness
  ) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    results_g2$nodes %>%
      dplyr::select(
        -network
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        degree_female =
          degree,

        clustering_coefficient_female =
          clustering_coefficient,

        closeness_female =
          closeness,

        eccentricity_female =
          eccentricity,

        stress_female =
          stress,

        betweenness_female =
          betweenness
      ),
    by = "node"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    node_status = case_when(
      !is.na(degree_male) &
        !is.na(degree_female) ~
        "shared",

      !is.na(degree_male) &
        is.na(degree_female) ~
        "male_only",

      is.na(degree_male) &
        !is.na(degree_female) ~
        "female_only",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    degree_change =
      degree_female -
      degree_male,

    clustering_coefficient_change =
      clustering_coefficient_female -
      clustering_coefficient_male,

    closeness_change =
      closeness_female -
      closeness_male,

    eccentricity_change =
      eccentricity_female -
      eccentricity_male,

    stress_change =
      stress_female -
      stress_male,

    betweenness_change =
      betweenness_female -
      betweenness_male
  )


# ============================================================
# SAVE NODE COMPARISON

readr::write_csv(

# ============================================================
# EDGE COMPARISON

edge_comparison <- results_g1$edges %>%
  dplyr::select(
    edge_id,

    weight_male =
      weight,

    sign_male =

  dplyr::full_join(

        node1,
        node2,

        weight_female =
          weight,

        sign_female =
          sign,

        edge_betweenness_female =
          edge_betweenness
      ),
    by = c(
      "edge_id",
      "node1",
      "node2"
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# CLASSIFY EDGE STATUS AND SIGN CHANGES
# ============================================================

edge_comparison <- edge_comparison %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    edge_status = case_when(

      !is.na(weight_male) &
        !is.na(weight_female) ~
        "shared",

      !is.na(weight_male) &
        is.na(weight_female) ~
        "male_only",

      is.na(weight_male) &
        !is.na(weight_female) ~
        "female_only",

      TRUE ~
        NA_character_
    ),

    sign_change = case_when(

      edge_status != "shared" ~
        NA_character_,

      sign_male == "positive" &
        sign_female == "negative" ~
        "positive_to_negative",

      sign_male == "negative" &
        sign_female == "positive" ~
        "negative_to_positive",

      sign_male == "positive" &
        sign_female == "positive" ~
        "positive_to_positive",

      sign_male == "negative" &
        sign_female == "negative" ~
        "negative_to_negative",

      sign_male == "zero" &
        sign_female == "positive" ~
        "zero_to_positive",

      sign_male == "zero" &
        sign_female == "negative" ~
        "zero_to_negative",

      sign_male == "positive" &
        sign_female == "zero" ~
        "positive_to_zero",

      sign_male == "negative" &
        sign_female == "zero" ~
        "negative_to_zero",

      sign_male == "zero" &
        sign_female == "zero" ~
        "zero_to_zero",

      TRUE ~
        "other"
    ),

    edge_betweenness_change =
      edge_betweenness_female -
      edge_betweenness_male
  )

edge_comparison <- edge_comparison %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sign_change = dplyr::case_when(
      edge_status != "shared" ~ NA_character_,

      sign_male == "positive" &
        sign_female == "negative" ~
        "positive_to_negative",

      sign_male == "negative" &
        sign_female == "positive" ~
        "negative_to_positive",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    edge_betweenness_change =
      edge_betweenness_female -
      edge_betweenness_male
  )

# ============================================================
# SAVE COMPLETE EDGE COMPARISON
# ============================================================

readr::write_csv(

# ============================================================
```

## statistical analyses
```{r}
# ============================================================
# STATISTICAL COMPARISON OF NODE AND EDGE PROPERTIES
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(purrr)


# ============================================================
# NODE-LEVEL PROPERTIES
#
# Compare only nodes present in BOTH networks.
# Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test.
# ============================================================

node_metrics <- c(
  "degree",
  "clustering_coefficient",
  "closeness",
  "eccentricity",
  "stress",
  "betweenness"
)


# ============================================================
# FUNCTION FOR PAIRED NODE TEST
# ============================================================

test_node_metric <- function(
  metric,
  node_df
) {

  male_col <- paste0(
    metric,
    "_male"
  )

  female_col <- paste0(
    metric,
    "_female"
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Keep only shared nodes with both measurements available
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  test_df <- node_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      node_status == "shared"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      node,
      male = dplyr::all_of(male_col),
      female = dplyr::all_of(female_col)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(male),
      !is.na(female),
      is.finite(male),
      is.finite(female)
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Require enough matched nodes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (nrow(test_df) < 2) {

    return(
      tibble(
        level = "node",
        metric = metric,
        n_pairs = nrow(test_df),
        mean_male = NA_real_,
        sd_male = NA_real_,
        median_male = NA_real_,
        iqr_male = NA_real_,
        mean_female = NA_real_,
        sd_female = NA_real_,
        median_female = NA_real_,
        iqr_female = NA_real_,
        median_difference = NA_real_,
        statistic = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  wt <- wilcox.test(
    x = test_df$female,
    y = test_df$male,
    paired = TRUE,
    exact = FALSE
  )

  tibble(
    level = "node",
    metric = metric,

    n_pairs = nrow(
      test_df
    ),

    mean_male = mean(
      test_df$male
    ),

    sd_male = sd(
      test_df$male
    ),

    median_male = median(
      test_df$male
    ),

    iqr_male = IQR(
      test_df$male
    ),

    mean_female = mean(
      test_df$female
    ),

    sd_female = sd(
      test_df$female
    ),

    median_female = median(
      test_df$female
    ),

    iqr_female = IQR(
      test_df$female
    ),

    median_difference = median(
      test_df$female -
        test_df$male
    ),

    statistic = unname(
      wt$statistic
    ),

    p_value = wt$p.value
  )
}


# ============================================================
# RUN NODE TESTS
# ============================================================

node_stats_tests <- purrr::map_dfr(
  node_metrics,
  test_node_metric,
  node_df = node_comparison
)


# ============================================================
# MULTIPLE-TESTING CORRECTION
# ============================================================

node_stats_tests <- node_stats_tests %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adjust_fdr = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# PRINT NODE RESULTS
# ============================================================

print(
  node_stats_tests
)

# ============================================================
# EDGE-LEVEL TEST
#
# Edge betweenness:
# paired Wilcoxon test among shared edges only
# ============================================================

shared_edges <- edge_comparison %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    edge_status == "shared",
    !is.na(edge_betweenness_male),
    !is.na(edge_betweenness_female),
    is.finite(edge_betweenness_male),
    is.finite(edge_betweenness_female)
  )


# ============================================================
# EDGE BETWEENNESS TEST
# ============================================================

if (nrow(shared_edges) >= 2) {

  edge_betweenness_test <- wilcox.test(
    x = shared_edges$edge_betweenness_female,
    y = shared_edges$edge_betweenness_male,
    paired = TRUE,
    exact = FALSE
  )

  edge_stats_test <- tibble(
    level = "edge",

    metric = "edge_betweenness",

    n_pairs = nrow(
      shared_edges
    ),

    mean_male = mean(
      shared_edges$edge_betweenness_male
    ),

    sd_male = sd(
      shared_edges$edge_betweenness_male
    ),

    median_male = median(
      shared_edges$edge_betweenness_male
    ),

    iqr_male = IQR(
      shared_edges$edge_betweenness_male
    ),

    mean_female = mean(
      shared_edges$edge_betweenness_female
    ),

    sd_female = sd(
      shared_edges$edge_betweenness_female
    ),

    median_female = median(
      shared_edges$edge_betweenness_female
    ),

    iqr_female = IQR(
      shared_edges$edge_betweenness_female
    ),

    median_difference = median(
      shared_edges$edge_betweenness_female -
        shared_edges$edge_betweenness_male
    ),

    statistic = unname(
      edge_betweenness_test$statistic
    ),

    p_value = edge_betweenness_test$p.value
  )

} else {

  edge_stats_test <- tibble(
    level = "edge",
    metric = "edge_betweenness",
    n_pairs = nrow(shared_edges),
    mean_male = NA_real_,
    sd_male = NA_real_,
    median_male = NA_real_,
    iqr_male = NA_real_,
    mean_female = NA_real_,
    sd_female = NA_real_,
    median_female = NA_real_,
    iqr_female = NA_real_,
    median_difference = NA_real_,
    statistic = NA_real_,
    p_value = NA_real_
  )
}

# ============================================================
# COMBINE NODE + EDGE RESULTS
# ============================================================

graph_stats_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  node_stats_tests,
  edge_stats_test
)

print(
  graph_stats_df
)

# ============================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# ============================================================

readr::write_csv(
  graph_stats_df,
  file.path(
    outdir,
    "network_property_statistical_tests.csv"
  )
)

negative_edge_comparison <- results_g1$global %>%
  dplyr::select(
    percent_negative_edges
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    percent_negative_edges_male =
      percent_negative_edges
  ) %>%
  dplyr::bind_cols(
    results_g2$global %>%
      dplyr::select(
        percent_negative_edges
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        percent_negative_edges_female =
          percent_negative_edges
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    difference =
      percent_negative_edges_female -
      percent_negative_edges_male
  )

print(
  negative_edge_comparison
)

readr::write_csv(
  negative_edge_comparison,
  file.path(
    outdir,
    "percent_negative_edges_comparison.csv"
  )
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# CHI-SQUARE TEST:
# PROPORTION OF NEGATIVE EDGES
# ============================================================

negative_edge_counts <- tibble::tibble(
  network = c(
    "male",
    "female"
  ),

  negative = c(
    sum(results_g1$edges$weight < 0),
    sum(results_g2$edges$weight < 0)
  ),

  non_negative = c(
    sum(results_g1$edges$weight >= 0),
    sum(results_g2$edges$weight >= 0)
  )
)

print(
  negative_edge_counts
)

negative_edge_table <- as.matrix(
  negative_edge_counts %>%
    dplyr::select(
      negative,
      non_negative
    )
)

rownames(
  negative_edge_table
) <- negative_edge_counts$network

print(
  negative_edge_table
)

negative_edge_chisq <- chisq.test(
  negative_edge_table,
  correct = FALSE
)

print(
  negative_edge_chisq
)

negative_edge_chisq$expected
```

```{r}
negative_edge_stats <- negative_edge_counts %>%

      negative +
      non_negative,

    percent_negative =
      100 *
      negative /
      total_edges

negative_edge_test_results <- tibble::tibble(
  test = "Chi-square test of negative-edge proportion",

  male_negative_edges =
    negative_edge_stats$negative[
      negative_edge_stats$network == "male"
    ],

  male_total_edges =
    negative_edge_stats$total_edges[
      negative_edge_stats$network == "male"

  male_percent_negative =

      negative_edge_stats$network == "male"
    ],

  female_negative_edges =
    negative_edge_stats$negative[
      negative_edge_stats$network == "female"
    ],

  female_total_edges =
    negative_edge_stats$total_edges[
      negative_edge_stats$network == "female"
    ],

  female_percent_negative =
    negative_edge_stats$percent_negative[
      negative_edge_stats$network == "female"
    ],

  chi_square =
    unname(
      negative_edge_chisq$statistic
    ),

  df =
    unname(
      negative_edge_chisq$parameter
    ),

  p_value =
    negative_edge_chisq$p.value
)

print(
  negative_edge_test_results
)

readr::write_csv(
  negative_edge_test_results,
  file.path(
    outdir,
    "negative_edge_chisquare_test.csv"
  )
)
```

## male extended (not going to use)
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Signed weighted GraphML network analysis
# ============================================================

library(igraph)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

# ============================================================
# Input
# ============================================================

graph_file <- here("data/cytoscape/male_network.graphml")

g <- read_graph(
  graph_file,
  format = "graphml"
)

# ============================================================
# Basic QC
# ============================================================

print(g)

message("Directed: ", is_directed(g))
message("Nodes: ", vcount(g))
message("Edges: ", ecount(g))

message(
  "Edge attributes: ",
  paste(edge_attr_names(g), collapse = ", ")
)

message(
  "Vertex attributes: ",
  paste(vertex_attr_names(g), collapse = ", ")
)

# ============================================================
# Check weights
# ============================================================

if (!"weight" %in% edge_attr_names(g)) {
  stop("No edge attribute named 'weight' was found.")
}

E(g)$weight <- as.numeric(E(g)$weight)

if (anyNA(E(g)$weight)) {
  warning("Some edge weights are NA.")
}

message(
  "Weight range: ",
  paste(
    range(E(g)$weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    collapse = " to "
  )
)

message(
  "Positive edges: ",
  sum(E(g)$weight > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
)

message(
  "Negative edges: ",
  sum(E(g)$weight < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# ============================================================
# Edge weight representations
# ============================================================

E(g)$abs_weight <- abs(E(g)$weight)

E(g)$sign <- case_when(
  E(g)$weight > 0 ~ "positive",
  E(g)$weight < 0 ~ "negative",
  TRUE ~ "zero"
)

E(g)$positive_weight <- pmax(
  E(g)$weight,
  0
)

E(g)$negative_weight <- pmax(
  -E(g)$weight,
  0
)

epsilon <- 1e-8

E(g)$distance_abs <- 1 / (
  E(g)$abs_weight + epsilon
)

# ============================================================
# GLOBAL NETWORK STATISTICS
# ============================================================

comp <- components(g)

degree_values <- degree(
  g,
  mode = "all"
)

abs_strength <- strength(
  g,
  mode = "all",
  weights = E(g)$abs_weight
)

signed_strength <- strength(
  g,
  mode = "all",
  weights = E(g)$weight
)

global_stats <- tibble(
  n_nodes = vcount(g),
  n_edges = ecount(g),

  density = edge_density(
    g,
    loops = FALSE
  ),

  n_components = comp$no,

  largest_component_n = max(
    comp$csize
  ),

  mean_degree = mean(
    degree_values
  ),

  median_degree = median(
    degree_values
  ),

  mean_abs_strength = mean(
    abs_strength
  ),

  mean_signed_strength = mean(
    signed_strength
  ),

  mean_edge_weight = mean(
    E(g)$weight,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  mean_abs_edge_weight = mean(
    E(g)$abs_weight,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  median_abs_edge_weight = median(
    E(g)$abs_weight,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  proportion_positive = mean(
    E(g)$weight > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  proportion_negative = mean(
    E(g)$weight < 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  degree_assortativity = assortativity_degree(
    g,
    directed = FALSE
  ),

  global_transitivity = transitivity(
    g,
    type = "global"
  )
)

print(global_stats)

# ============================================================
# Largest connected component
# ============================================================

largest_component_id <- which.max(
  comp$csize
)

g_lcc <- induced_subgraph(
  g,
  vids = which(
    comp$membership == largest_component_id
  )
)

E(g_lcc)$distance_abs <- 1 / (
  abs(E(g_lcc)$weight) + epsilon
)

global_stats$mean_path_length_abs <- mean_distance(
  g_lcc,
  directed = FALSE,
  weights = E(g_lcc)$distance_abs
)

global_stats$diameter_abs <- diameter(
  g_lcc,
  directed = FALSE,
  weights = E(g_lcc)$distance_abs
)

# ============================================================
# NODE-LEVEL STATISTICS
# ============================================================

node_names <- V(g)$name

if (is.null(node_names)) {
  node_names <- as.character(
    seq_len(vcount(g))
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Degree
# ------------------------------------------------------------

node_degree <- degree(
  g,
  mode = "all"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Absolute strength
# ------------------------------------------------------------

node_abs_strength <- strength(
  g,
  mode = "all",
  weights = E(g)$abs_weight
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Signed/net strength
# ------------------------------------------------------------

node_signed_strength <- strength(
  g,
  mode = "all",
  weights = E(g)$weight
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Positive and negative strength
# ------------------------------------------------------------

positive_strength <- rep(
  0,
  vcount(g)
)

negative_strength <- rep(
  0,
  vcount(g)
)

positive_degree <- rep(
  0,
  vcount(g)
)

negative_degree <- rep(
  0,
  vcount(g)
)

edge_ends <- ends(
  g,
  E(g),
  names = FALSE
)

for (i in seq_len(ecount(g))) {

  a <- edge_ends[i, 1]
  b <- edge_ends[i, 2]

  w <- E(g)$weight[i]

  if (w > 0) {

    positive_strength[a] <- positive_strength[a] + w
    positive_strength[b] <- positive_strength[b] + w

    positive_degree[a] <- positive_degree[a] + 1
    positive_degree[b] <- positive_degree[b] + 1

  } else if (w < 0) {

    negative_strength[a] <- negative_strength[a] + abs(w)
    negative_strength[b] <- negative_strength[b] + abs(w)

    negative_degree[a] <- negative_degree[a] + 1
    negative_degree[b] <- negative_degree[b] + 1
  }
}

# ============================================================
# Path-based node centrality
# ============================================================

node_betweenness <- betweenness(
  g,
  directed = FALSE,
  weights = E(g)$distance_abs,
  normalized = TRUE
)

node_closeness <- closeness(
  g,
  mode = "all",
  weights = E(g)$distance_abs,
  normalized = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# Local topology
# ============================================================

local_clustering <- transitivity(
  g,
  type = "local",
  isolates = "zero"
)

mean_neighbor_degree <- knn(
  g
)$knn

node_stats <- tibble(
  node = node_names,

  degree = node_degree,

  positive_degree = positive_degree,

  negative_degree = negative_degree,

  abs_strength = node_abs_strength,

  positive_strength = positive_strength,

  negative_strength = negative_strength,

  signed_strength = node_signed_strength,

  betweenness_abs = node_betweenness,

  closeness_abs = node_closeness,

  local_clustering = local_clustering,

  mean_neighbor_degree = mean_neighbor_degree
)

node_stats <- node_stats %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    negative_edge_fraction =
      negative_degree /
      pmax(degree, 1),

    negative_strength_fraction =
      negative_strength /
      pmax(abs_strength, 1e-12),

    strength_balance =
      positive_strength -
      negative_strength
  )

# ============================================================
# EDGE-LEVEL STATISTICS
# ============================================================

edge_df <- as_data_frame(
  g,
  what = "edges"
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    edge_id = seq_len(n())
  )

edge_df <- edge_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    weight = as.numeric(weight),

    abs_weight = abs(weight),

    sign = case_when(
      weight > 0 ~ "positive",
      weight < 0 ~ "negative",
      TRUE ~ "zero"
    )
  )

edge_df$edge_betweenness <- edge_betweenness(
  g,
  directed = FALSE,
  weights = E(g)$distance_abs
)

edge_common_neighbors <- numeric(
  ecount(g)
)

edge_jaccard <- numeric(
  ecount(g)
)

for (i in seq_len(ecount(g))) {

  a <- edge_ends[i, 1]
  b <- edge_ends[i, 2]

  neighbors_a <- as.integer(
    neighbors(
      g,
      a,
      mode = "all"
    )
  )

  neighbors_b <- as.integer(
    neighbors(
      g,
      b,
      mode = "all"
    )
  )

  common_neighbors <- intersect(
    neighbors_a,
    neighbors_b
  )

  union_neighbors <- union(
    neighbors_a,
    neighbors_b
  )

  edge_common_neighbors[i] <- length(
    common_neighbors
  )

  edge_jaccard[i] <- ifelse(
    length(union_neighbors) == 0,
    0,
    length(common_neighbors) /
      length(union_neighbors)
  )
}

edge_df$common_neighbors <- edge_common_neighbors
# edge_df$jaccard <- edge_jaccard

# bridge_ids <- bridges(g)
# 
# edge_df$is_bridge <- seq_len(
#   ecount(g)
# ) %in% bridge_ids

edge_df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    edge_id,
    from,
    to,
    weight,
    abs_weight,
    sign,
    edge_betweenness,
    common_neighbors,
    jaccard,
  #  is_bridge,
    dplyr::everything()
  )
```
